summary: 47-year-old woman attempting to free-solo "The Spy" in Chautauqua Park got off route onto the face of the First Flatiron and became stuck, unable to continue up or down; nearby climbers confirmed she was uninjured and called 911 ~10:12 a.m.; OSMP rangers and Rocky Mountain Rescue Group rappelled to her, secured her, and lowered her on a rope system; she hiked out uninjured.
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; City of Boulder Open Space and Mountain Parks; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group
